text:
Maria D: quick design check — I'm worried the error-count badge in the request drilldown is ambiguous. Right now it reads `Errors 12` and sits right next to the status chip. Hard to scan.
Cheng W: agree. From a glance it looks like part of the status. We talked about using color + a compact label, e.g. `12 errors (5m)` or `Errors • 12`.
Samir K: leaning toward `Errors • 12` — shorter and consistent with other pills. But we should include time window somewhere. Maybe tooltip: `12 errors in last 5 minutes`.
Olivia: accessibility nit: screen readers currently read the badge as "12" only. We need an `aria-label` like `12 errors in the last 5 minutes` so it's clear. Also keyboard focus should land on the badge before the export button.
Maria D: good call. Proposal: change visible text to `Errors • 12` + `aria-label=\"12 errors in last 5 minutes\"`. Move it into the header flow so tab order is: status → errors → actions.
Cheng W: sounds good. Another thing — export actions. Right now the big primary button says `Export` and opens a modal with two tabs: `Snapshot` and `Stream`. Feels magical. Any copy ideas to make affordances clearer?
Samir K: UX suggestion: label primary `Download snapshot` and secondary `Stream live` (under a chevron menu). That makes intent explicit.
Olivia: also for keyboard users, `Stream live` should be reachable via the menu and have `aria-pressed` state while active. When streaming, the export button should change to `Stop stream` and show a live indicator `● live`.
Maria D: if we rename primary to `Download snapshot`, we need to surface file format and size hint. Maybe small muted text: `JSON · ~120KB` after the CTA when applicable.
Cheng W: copy proposals for modal header: instead of `Export`, use `Export trace` with subtitle `Choose a snapshot or stream events to see incoming errors.` Short and scannable.
Samir K: example snippet for the export summary area (for devs):
```
Export trace
• Format: JSON
• Window: last 5m
• Includes: request, spans, stacktrace
```
Olivia: accessibility callout — when the modal opens focus should move to the modal title. Also add `role=\"status\"` to the streaming counter so assistive tech read the live updates (`Streaming: 42 events`).
ExportBot: deploy-preview built for the badge + export copy tweaks at https://deploy.redwood/local/trace-export-1754329 :warning: uses test data.
Maria D: thanks bot. Once devs confirm keyboard order and aria-labels I'll update the figma components. Anything else?
Cheng W: one more visual detail: contrast. The dot used in `Errors • 12` is very low contrast on light theme; use a medium gray or small separator instead.
Samir K: +1. Also propose we add a tiny hover affordance that shows `Download (ctrl/cmd + d)` shortcut.
Olivia: looks ready. I'll write the accessibility checklist items and add to the PR. :thumbsup:
Maria D: perfect — I'll iterate the figma and post the updated screens here.
